headline: Two breaking-but-intentional token changes landed today. #228 collapsed four competing radius values onto one knob (semantic.radius.action 12px -> 8px; Tailwind rounded-md now resolves to the role radius exactly, so the utility and the token can no longer disagree) and unblocked Storybook, which had not built on a clean clone because two generated-but-gitignored JSON files are imported as modules. #208 neutralized the accent from blue to monochrome, inverting per theme, taking content.onAccent/surface.accent contrast from 7.3:1 to 18.9:1; blue is now a tenant overlay rather than the base. A rendered-evidence audit, a target-architecture proposal for all 120 components, and a knob bench (pnpm preview:build) that renders the real components with live dials shipped alongside. Epic #124 decomposed: 6 of its 9 children were already closed, #134 closed as superseded, and 7 new issues filed (#230-#236).
next: PR #237 — pnpm tokens truncated the manifest by seven entries because it skipped enrich-manifest; check-manifest-drift could not see it because the names sit in both componentSpecs and utilities and the gate unioned them
Fix #225 (radio paints nothing, segmented items 1.00:1, toggle a transparent box) and #226 (alert title runs into body) — in progress on claude/fix-form-control-rendering
Fix #227 (type scale inverts: 5xl 80px > 7xl 72px) — in progress on claude/fix-type-scale-inversion
#230 — split the border token so control boundaries meet WCAG 1.4.11; --semantic-color-border-default is 1.26:1 against a 3:1 floor
#186 — 60 pre-existing check-tier-bypass violations, held until the form-control work lands to avoid file contention
blocked: Adrian: #235 — ratify or redline the core/pattern/internal/fold disposition table. Default applies 2026-10-03 if unanswered
Adrian: #236 — commit the first figma/snapshot.json; check:figma-drift is dark until one exists, and a live Figma write is Adrian session-only
Adrian: #126 — CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN in Actions secrets. Re-claimed by the loop 8 times with the same blocker; marked do-not-re-dispatch

Adrian: #199 — release is held by an org-level policy, not a repo setting. GitHub org hirobius -> Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions -> Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests. Nothing publishes past 0.13.0 until this is ticked
